{{Quote|We must remain philosophical and flexible. Our original plan was thwarted, but we will make adjustments. We can no longer cause a war between S'krrr and Rabaan. But we will use this Rebel base as an excuse to garrison the system.|[[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Klime]]|<ref name="CM" />}}
'''Operation Peacemaker''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] operation conceived by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Klime]] to justify the deployment of Imperial troops in the [[Ishanna system/Legends|Ishanna system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The initial plan was to turn the [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[S'krrr (species)|S'krrr]] inhabitants of the [[Ishanna system/Legends|Ishanna system]] against each other. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Modigal Glave]] attempted to trick both sides into believing the other betrayed them during the [[The Combat|ritual Combat]] on the [[Combat Moon]].<ref name="CM" />
